scope: Independent local infrastructure review; source fetch and production model invocations were not performed by this review.

targetedTests.command: npx vitest run test/lesson-generate.test.ts test/lesson-status.test.ts test/lessons.test.ts test/db-guard-audit.test.ts test/lesson-sources.test.ts test/lesson-source-verify.test.ts

closedFindings: Coverage audit shares the public reader containment, regular-file and 512 KiB boundaries.
Full curriculum completion requires total=1600 and reviewed=1600, separately from a small database completion.
Read-only database opener is production-guarded and covered by the static CLI audit; isolated database bytes remain unchanged.
Failed and timed-out generation output cannot be restored as a successful draft.
Saved generation/final bytes are hash-bound; changed bytes invalidate resume, while an intact success resumes without model calls.
Patch failures leave the original draft unchanged and cannot modify word identity.
Review coverage references must exist and cover every core sense, including on cached review reuse and publication.
Publication uses the bound raw review and replays patches to reproduce the final lesson; a changed shared review.json cannot substitute another audit.
One generator lock covers generation and review; simulated progress-write failure still releases the lock.
Invalid or draft destination files are reported explicitly and not silently skipped or overwritten.
Final serialized lesson bytes use the same 512 KiB delivery limit.
Malformed or misspelled CLI flags are rejected before opening a database.
Cambridge inventories include only exact headword entry-body__el blocks, preserving case/punctuation and explicit AmE aliases.
limitations: This is infrastructure and provenance verification, not a teacher audit of generated language content.
The test uses isolated temporary databases and fake model runners; it makes no claim of full 1600 lesson completion.
The newly added CLI failure circuit was inspected in code but was not separately fault-injected in this review.
